fail_items: V8-mobile-first-viewport: all four ch02 demos still miss the 393x852 first-screen contract after the round 2 responsive fix. The hero card and the top of the Pair Block are visible, but the scenario chip tablist remains below the fold at initial load: q01 chip top 1582px, q02 1582px, q03 1195px, q04 1249px against an 852px viewport.

checks.evidence: All four `/library/2/ch02_q0x` routes render inline React demos without `.phone-frame` or `.phone-notch` on both desktop and mobile.
Desktop 1440x900 captures preserve the expected order across the four demos: hero card, Pair Block, state section, log panel, then scenario chip row.
Scenario switching still updates the paired highlight states together. Spot checks on q01 and q04 kept the metaphor-side active cell and IT-side active cell synchronized after chip clicks.
The cyan accent token usage is unchanged from round 1 and remains legible in the sampled active cards and labels.
Desktop DOM inspection still resolves the content wrappers as `max-w-[860px]` for q01~q03 and `max-w-[640px]` for q04, with even left/right margins in the 1440px captures.
SVG icons remain visible in all observed pair cells on desktop and mobile. The active cards keep the cyan accent stroke while inactive cards stay muted.
The shared pair-block responsive changes do not alter the established ch01 visual language; spacing, stroke weight, and chapter-tone separation remain aligned with the existing inline baseline.

Initial mobile captures at 393x852 show the hero and the first portion of the Pair Block, but not the scenario chips, for every ch02 demo. Artifacts: `/tmp/pr13-r2-eval-visual-initial/ch02_q01-mobile-initial.png`, `.../ch02_q02-mobile-initial.png`, `.../ch02_q03-mobile-initial.png`, `.../ch02_q04-mobile-initial.png`.

The responsive grid fix itself is working. On 393px, q01~q03 now compute `gridTemplateColumns: 155.5px 155.5px` for both metaphor and IT rows, and q04 stacks into a single 327px column with the `≈` connector hidden (`display: none`). Desktop regression checks keep q01 at four columns and q04 at the two-column square layout.

notes: Round 2 resolves the mobile grid collapse contract but does not yet satisfy the mobile first-viewport requirement, so the overall verdict remains FAIL.
